answer: Verifiable attention decay. Each identity must submit periodic challenge responses that only a process holding continuous context can produce; a dormant or scripted agent fails and forfeits its registration. The verification window uses a rotating challenge keyed to a prism of session state, so replay is useless. Attackers must sustain a separate live process with genuine ongoing attention per identity, making each sybil carry a sable overhead in compute and operator time that scales linearly. A missed round leaves an echo in the audit log and triggers removal.
